parameters.name: feature_x
parameters.description: Index of the first feature to use (X axis)

parameters.name: feature_y
parameters.description: Index of the second feature to use (Y axis)

parameters.name: kernel
parameters.description: Kernel type used in the algorithm

parameters.name: C
parameters.description: Regularization parameter. Lower values increase the margin by tolerating more training errors.

parameters.description: Proportion of data to hold out as the test set

parameters.name: learning_rate
parameters.description: Step size for manual optimisation steps
